title: Settings » General Settings » Integrations Tab
text:
## Settings » General Settings » Integrations Tab
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000050980
This article explains the Integrations Tab in the General Settings Tab and all the settings within this tab. This section of the admin area is used to set up different API keys and add-ons.
Important: A live domain needs to be connected before editing this section of the admin.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12177885635/original/nsltrMmbngG5sTfIBgmbbHcQrNa-w3n8LQ.png?1776884698 | alt: ]
For new sites launched using a directoryup.com subdomain, test mode credentials for the ReCaptcha and Google Maps API are already active. Once the site is switched to a real domain, these test credentials will stop working, and new credentials will need to be configured. To learn more about this, please follow this link: directoryup.com Subdomain Test Credentials
There is an option to VIEW these settings, but in order to edit the settings, a domain must be connected. To learn how to set the domain live, please follow this link: How To Move The Site To A Live Domain

## Integrations
Once the site is connected to a live domain, the following can be edited:

## 1. Block Spam Keywords
This is a comma separated list of keywords to block form submissions on sign up pages and public forms. To learn more about this click here: Spam Form Protector Add-On TIP : Add keywords in "quotes" to target exact matches rather than any partial match (more specific targeting)
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12140065610/original/_rgg2z8Xtfs3FuQPrzL0_SzKViHSo61CZg.png?1710259210 | alt: ]

## 2. Google Analytics
Google Analytics ID
Enter Google Analytics 4 ID. Format G-XXXXXXX. To learn more about Google Analytics, click here: Installing Google Analytics Tracking Code (easy method)
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12086351027/original/55jpgOUpwl8pqUNM4KeWAcA23vUOfG2Tlw.png?1608052553 | alt: ]

## 3. Google Maps JavaScript API Key
This is the field where the Google Maps API Key should be added. To learn more about this click here: How to Enable Maps with Google Maps API
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12086351048/original/Ln9wo3L2sEExmFfdKQUXpSDbsV8UbkTyxQ.png?1608052583 | alt: ]

## 4. Google ReCaptcha Site key
This is the field where the Google ReCaptcha Site Key should be added. To learn more about this, click here: How to Enable Form Security with Google reCaptcha
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12132168268/original/Uk-wFiEv7WOxwcIhit0w3JEqL7f--fXu7A.png?1696291083 | alt: ]

## 5. Google ReCaptcha Secret Key
This is the field where the Google ReCaptcha Secret Key should be added.

## 6. Google Developer Client ID (for social login add-on)
This is the field where the Google Developer Client ID (for social login) should be entered. To learn more this, click here: Google Login Add-On
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12132168518/original/SHv7ECZ9fym1pKeuOZKseiCPEhe5jW4qMw.png?1696291551 | alt: ]

## 7. Enable Google Login?
Allow members to login with their Google account. Allow members to sign up with their Google Account in the Product Settings
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12132168529/original/BFKPeeibXt-gdOYZ5LGDJLlDMQ_4VTNUUw.png?1696291672 | alt: ]

## 8. Facebook App ID (for social login add-on)
This field is where the Facebook App ID (for social login) should be entered . To learn more about this, click here: Facebook Login Add-On
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12132170801/original/gabQS1fmWh4mgDC0o3JhRiuCFPVg3Scegw.png?1696294484 | alt: ]

## 9. Enable Facebook Login?
Allow members to login with their Facebook account. Allow members to sign up with their Facebook Account in the Product Settings
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12132168643/original/c5sc-HIq0ftcaSowWWq3D4pKWEOqUh3zdw.png?1696291884 | alt: ]

## 10. Facebook App Secret ID (for social login add-on callback delete)
Enter Secret ID for Facebook App (for Social Login delete)
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12132168651/original/jlpmBQZfKmul5Cb0qkMQF6O3sVTYFgPIKQ.png?1696291943 | alt: ]

## 11. Enable Private Chat Messages for Members?
If YES, this will also need to be activated to each specific membership plans. To learn more about this, click here: Private Member Chat
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12132168925/original/b9t6HeTu1Rl64UXb6uUiq0qJIj8_E4oh1w.png?1696292232 | alt: ]

## 12. Send Email Notifications to Members
Send Email Notifications when Chat Messages are Sent
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12132169296/original/8AJnAfl0CZ6JDDBzNc_naWqprcsIhPUolw.png?1696292315 | alt: ]

## 13. Send Email Notification to Admin When Private Chat Reported?
Send an email notification to the Admin of the site when a member flags / reports a private chat message.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12132169896/original/H82Y59E1XLLGwn67gCxljaO9A5Ha4gZWZQ.png?1696292416 | alt: ]

## 14. Select Transaction Types to Track
This setting will control when the affiliate tracking code will be triggered.
The options are:
Member Sign Ups
Member Upgrades
Member Lead Purchases
Digital Product Purchases
Pay-Per-Post Purchase
To learn more about this, click here: Affiliate Program Integrations
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12176453817/original/p8kktwiG5jfDG77GZwAPL5ajFcYpl94Ztg.png?1774375345 | alt: ]

## 15. PostAffiliatePro URL
This setting will include the PostAffiliatePro tracking code to successful signups. IMPORTANT: Do not include http or www.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12132170211/original/ugDKtRsWd6WABOC8E-GwI5ekhaOoHG16LQ.png?1696292742 | alt: ]

## 16. ChatGPT API Key
Enter the ChatGPT API Key. Click here to learn more about ChatGPT
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12132170223/original/WDB4ucefCNd69r_vvIlhwozlhuRe5dnoEg.png?1696292803 | alt: ]
